budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW requested a total budget that is higher than FY23 by a stated amount and percentage.
budget_items.quote: the dpw is requesting $2,168,287.64, which is $158,138 more (7.8 percent) than fy23.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new streetlights line item was added; the DPW estimates electricity will cost the town a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: a new line item for streetlights has been added, mr. bernard has estimated the electricity will cost the town $30,000.

budget_items.topic: Snow and ice overspending in FY23
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Snow and ice spending in FY23 is almost twice its budget amount and has reached a stated total.
budget_items.quote: mr. bernard has already had to spend almost twice the budget amount for snow and ice in fy23, and is up to $684,650.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An increase is sought for cemetery shrubs and services.
budget_items.quote: a $12,911 increase is sought to purchase shrubs, and services for the cemetery department.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tree removal is estimated at a stated FY24 cost, up a stated amount from FY23.
budget_items.quote: tree removal is estimated to cost $33,500 in fy24, which is up $4,357 from fy23.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The new facilities department seeks increases for contracted services and parks salaries and contracted services.
budget_items.quote: the newly created facilities department will seek a $15,000 increase for contracted services, $5,000 for salaries for parks, and another $8,500 for contracted services exclusively for parks.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said it is possible a stated amount may be added to the capital plan.
budget_items.quote: it's possible $500,000 may be added to the plan.
